title: Customer release orchestration: email and in-app snippet library
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a modular library of customer-facing release communications for LTS upgrades, minor releases with migration steps, and emergency rollbacks. The library will include: 1) segmented email templates (enterprise, mid-market, startups), 2) concise in-app announcement snippets and banner copy, 3) short-form release note summaries suitable for Slack/Changelog feeds, and 4) a one-page migration checklist that engineers or SREs can attach to enterprise upgrade comms. Scope excludes deep technical migration guides (those live in Confluence/Docs and are referenced). The deliverables are designed to be reused by Sales, Customer Success, and Support during the migration window and to reduce manual copy edits when a release crosses multiple channels. This ticket covers crafting the templates, stakeholder reviews, + one pilot send for the upcoming runtime-1.18 maintenance window.
acceptance_criteria: Email templates for 3 customer segments exist (enterprise / mid-market / startup) and are approved by Legal and Security
In-app banner and modal snippets (short and long variants) are provided in plain text and MD for engineering to drop into the release pipeline
A 1-page migration checklist PDF is attached and links to canonical Confluence guides
A/B variants for subject lines and CTAs are drafted for the pilot and ready to be measured
All templates are stored in the central release-comm repo and linked from the console release workflow
Stakeholder signoffs recorded (PM, Design, Legal, Support, Solutions Eng)

communication_snippets: Enterprise email subject (A): Important: Planned LTS upgrade on {date} — action recommended
Enterprise email subject (B): Action required: Preparing your Redwood Inference environment for next LTS

Enterprise email body (short): Hi {contact_name}, we're deploying an LTS update (runtime-1.18) on {date}. Expected impact: short rolling restarts with <1% request retries for 5–10 minutes. Action: review the attached migration checklist and confirm readiness. Link to detailed migration guide: {confluence_link}. If you need a maintenance window, reply to this email or contact your CSM.

Mid-market email body: Hello {account_owner}, we will roll out a performance and stability update to our inference runtime on {date}. No immediate action required for most customers. If you run custom KV-cache workflows or pinned model variants, follow the 1-page checklist attached to validate compatibility.
Startup email body (concise): Heads-up — routine platform upgrade on {date}. Most teams will not need to do anything. If you see unexpected errors, file a ticket at support@redwood.example.
In-app banner (short): Scheduled platform update on {date}. Learn more [link].

In-app modal (long): We're upgrading our inference runtime (runtime-1.18) to improve latency and reliability. During the update some requests may be retried automatically. Review the checklist to confirm pinned versions and custom rollout rules. If you require a dedicated maintenance window, contact support.
Release note summary (1-line): runtime-1.18 — Improved batching heuristics, KV cache bugfixes, and safer canary fallback behavior (see migration checklist).

Migration checklist (bullets): 1) Confirm pinned model versions; 2) Validate KV cache settings; 3) Review custom routing policies; 4) Run smoke tests against canary; 5) Ensure alerting for increased 5xx rates. Confluence link: {confluence_link}
